titleStmt.title: King Śibi in the Itihāsasamuccaya
A critical edition of the śiber upākhyāna

summary.p: This edition of the Itihāsasamuccaya śiber upākhyāna, by Charles Li, is work in progress.

lg.l: kathayantaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs tathā |
lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 1 ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana || 2 ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 3 ||
idam eva purā devās tulayā samatolayan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||
atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanam |
indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśīnarasya ca || 5 ||
vartamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śibiṃ nṛpam |
indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto 'gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6 ||
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt |
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā || 8 ||
mahārāja kapoto 'yaṃ vidhātrā vihito mama |
bhakṣyo bubhuktā mahatī vartate visṛjyādya vai ||
kapoto 'yam atitrasyaḥ śaraṇārthī samāgataḥ |
tasmān na visṛjyāmy enaṃ dharmo me bhītapālanam ||
dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitam |
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||
dharmabuddhe kathaṃ tu tvāṃ haṃsi māṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā ||
dharmabudhyā tvayādharmaḥ kriyate sūkṣmabuddhinā ||
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinam |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || 10 ||
ko 'yaṃ dharmas tavedānīm ahaṃ vismayam īyivān |
asādhuḥ pālyate rājan sādhur vai pālyate tvayā ||
nopakārapare 'py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare 'pi tvam upakaraparo yathā || 11 ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe 'pi tvam apāpakṛt |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣe 'pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 12 ||
tad eṣa vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |
mā hiṃsīr lobhato dharmaṃ dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||
adharmaṃ pālayad dharmaṃ māvadhīr iti me matiḥ ||
vidvadbhir garhitaṃ karma na rājan karttum arhasi ||
ekasya pālate hiṃsā bahūnāṃ tvaṃ na paśyasi
ahaṃ ca sahacāriṇyāṃ pitarau me stutās tathā ||
ādau rūpavināśanī kraśakarīkā yasya vidhvaṃsinī jñānaṃ maṃdakarītapakṣayakarī dharmasya nirmūlanī |
putrabhrātrakalatrabhedanakarī lajjākulachedanī sāmāṃ pīḍati sarvadoṣajananī prāṇāpahārī kṣudhā ||
saṃtrastarūpī trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ pālyo 'gṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14 ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya mayārthinaḥ ||
katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitam || 15 ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajeccharaṇāgatam ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||
śaraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit || 17 ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18 ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tathā || 19 ||
yannimittaṃ bhaved doṣas trāso vā krodha eva vā ||
āyāso vā yathā duṣṭam ekāṃtam api na tyajet || 20 ||
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||
jñeyas tenānumānena paro 'pi parirakṣitum || 21 ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītaṃ prāpayiṣye kapotakam ||
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyam ||
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam || 22 ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ dīnam arpayiṣye kapotakam ||
yad atra yuktam anyaṃ te vaktuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 23 ||
prāyaśaḥ puruṣā loke sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ |
gacchanti brahmasadanam iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||
ya evaṃ vihito dhātrā mama bhakṣyaṃ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛja nāhāraiḥ kāryam anyair nareśvara |
āhārāḥ sarvvabhūtāni sambhavanti janeśvara |
āhāreṇa vivardhante tena jīvanti caiva hi || 24 ||
śakyate 'nyair vināpy arthai rājan vartayituṃ ciram |
śakyate duṣkare 'py arthe cirarātreṇa jīvitum |
śakyate 'rthair vināpy arthai rājan vartayituṃ ciram |
nārthair anyair vināhāraṃ jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet |
na tv āhāravihīne na śakyaṃ vartayituṃ ciram || 25 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate |
vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyanti pantānam apunarbbhavam || 26 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati |
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi || 27 ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharma naiṣa dharmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī tayor yat syāt sa dharmaḥ sadbhir iṣyate || 28 ||
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyāmi padātam apunarbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvo me dāraputro mariṣyati ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya vicintya gurulāghavam |
yataḥ śreyas tato rājan kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ || 29 ||
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottamam |
suparṇapakṣirāṭ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na śaṃsayaḥ ||
yathā hi dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahucitraṃ prabāṣase |
na te hy aviditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ ||
nāto bhūyaḥ paro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 30 ||
varam ekasya satvasya dattvādyubhayadakṣiṇām |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṅkṛtam || 31 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana || 32 ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 33 ||
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalam |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 34 ||
tasmād dharmam imaṃ śyena sarvadharmottamottamam ||
bhītāya me kapotāya yat phalaṃ tan na vidyate ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ hutaṃ taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 35 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imām |
sattvebhyo 'bhayado yaś ca tayor abhayado 'dhikaḥ || 36 ||
